AI.description: Workers AI binding. Powers the `workers-ai` plugin **and** the `cf-ai-gateway` plugin (which fans out to 23+ providers). Free tier is sufficient to try the runtime.

AGENT_SESSIONS.description: Durable Object namespace for per-agent identity and SQLite-backed session storage. Auto-provisioned on first deploy.

CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN.description: Scoped Cloudflare API token used by the `cloudflare-api-mcp` plugin. Create one at [dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens](https://dash.cloudflare.com/profile/api-tokens) with the least-privilege scopes you need (for example `Zone:Read`, `DNS:Read`).

CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Your Cloudflare account id — required by the `cf-ai-gateway` plugin's compat REST fallback path. Find it in the [dashboard sidebar](https://dash.cloudflare.com/).

AI_GATEWAY_ID.description: Enables `cf-ai-gateway` — access **23+ providers** (Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, Groq, Mistral, DeepSeek, xAI, Cerebras, HuggingFace, and more) with BYOK via Secrets Store. Create the gateway at [dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/ai/ai-gateway](https://dash.cloudflare.com/?to=/:account/ai/ai-gateway) and store provider keys under **Provider Keys**.

AI_GATEWAY_AUTH_TOKEN.description: Optional bearer token for the gateway itself, if you've enabled gateway authentication.

CF_AI_GATEWAY_DEFAULT_MODEL.description: Default model for `cf-ai-gateway` calls when none is specified. Format: `provider/model-name`, e.g. `anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5`.

MCP_DEFAULT_URL.description: Optional default MCP server URL for the `mcp-client` plugin. Example: `https://mcp.cloudflare.com/mcp`.

MCP_BEARER_TOKEN.description: Optional bearer token for the default MCP server. Leave unset to use OAuth in your MCP client.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables the direct `anthropic` plugin (bypasses CF AI Gateway). Get one at [console.anthropic.com/settings/keys](https://console.anthropic.com/settings/keys).

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional. Enables `codex` plugin in classic API-key mode (billed at standard OpenAI API rates).

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_URL.description: Optional. Base URL of any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, Together, Ollama, etc.) for the direct `openai-compatible` plugin.

OPENAI_COMPATIBLE_KEY.description: Optional. API key for the configured OpenAI-compatible endpoint.

CODEX_ACCESS_TOKEN.description: **Use your ChatGPT Plus/Pro subscription** with the `codex` plugin. Run `codex login` locally, then copy the `access_token` from `~/.codex/auth.json` here. Calls route to `chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex` and count against your subscription quota.

CODEX_ID_TOKEN.description: Paired `id_token` from `~/.codex/auth.json` after `codex login`. Sent as `x-codex-id-token` header.

CODEX_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.description: **Roadmap** — registered OpenAI OAuth client id for the device-code flow at `/oauth/codex/device/*`.

CODEX_APP_SERVER_URL.description: **Recommended for subscription auth** — URL of a running `codex app-server` (either `wss://` for direct WebSocket JSON-RPC, or `https://` for a small HTTP shim). Enables thread/turn/model RPC and full Codex features without paste-in tokens. See [docs/CODEX_APPSERVER.md](./docs/CODEX_APPSERVER.md) for deployment recipes.

CODEX_APP_SERVER_TOKEN.description: Optional bearer token sent as `Authorization` on every JSON-RPC call to the app-server bridge. Use this if your tunnel / companion worker enforces auth.

CODEX_APP_SERVER_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Per-RPC timeout in milliseconds for app-server calls (default `30000`).

DB.description: **PA stack** — D1 database for memory facts, inbound email index, scheduled workflows, notifications audit log, and daily cost rollups. Run `wrangler d1 create tom-tom-pa` and paste the database_id into wrangler.toml.

MEMORY.description: **PA stack** (private beta) — Cloudflare Agent Memory binding. When unbound, the runtime falls back to the D1 `agent_memory` table automatically. No code change either way.

SEB.description: **PA stack** — Email Workers `send_email` binding. Required for `email-send` and the email channel of `notify-user`. Email Routing must be active on the sender domain with a verified destination.

BRIEFING_WORKFLOW.description: **PA stack** — Cloudflare Workflows binding for the morning briefing (durable, retriable). Wired to class `MorningBriefingWorkflow` exported from src/index.ts.

CF_ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: **PA stack** — your Cloudflare Access team domain, e.g. `https://yourname.cloudflareaccess.com`. Found in Zero Trust → Settings → General.

CF_ACCESS_AUD.description: **PA stack** — Application AUD tag for the Access app gating this Worker. Found on the app's Overview tab.

CF_ACCESS_ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: **PA stack** — optional comma-separated email allowlist. Defense-in-depth on top of the Access policy itself.

VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY.description: **PA stack** — Web Push VAPID public key (uncompressed P-256, base64url). Generate with `npm run vapid:generate`. Browsers fetch it from `/webpush/public-key`.

VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY.description: **PA stack** — Web Push VAPID private scalar (32 bytes, base64url). Keep as a secret, never as a var.

VAPID_SUBJECT.description: **PA stack** — VAPID `sub` claim (`mailto:you@example.com` or `https://...`). Push services use this to reach you if your VAPID identity is abused.

OWNER_EMAIL.description: **PA stack** — the inbox where the PA's notifications and morning briefing land.

FROM_EMAIL.description: **PA stack** — sender address for outbound email. Must be on a domain with Email Routing active (e.g. `helm@your-domain`).

DEFAULT_TIMEZONE.description: **PA stack** — IANA timezone for date-aware skills (briefings, calendar). Example: `America/New_York`.

DAILY_SPEND_CAP_USD.description: **PA stack** — hard daily ceiling for LLM spend. The runtime calls `enforceSpendingCap()` before non-trivial provider calls; once today's cost crosses the cap they're refused until 00:00 UTC.

INBOUND_FORWARD_TO.description: **PA stack** — optional verified destination to forward inbound mail to after the PA has indexed it (e.g. your real inbox).

CALENDAR_MCP_URL.description: **PA stack** — URL of an MCP server exposing calendar tools (Google Calendar / CalDAV / etc.). The `calendar` plugin delegates to this.
